mathematical_disposition: Confirmed: unspecified partition plus one common width is not a legal general invocation of uniform-grid midpoint provider.

Each cell has positive length and its single-panel midpoint is strictly interior; n=1 meets actual provider input guard. Its output is exactly the stated mass. Nonnegative density yields nonnegative masses. Arbitrary finite nonuniform partitions remain admitted.

A pointwise-evaluable density is only an optional initialization input. The general supplied finite initial quadrature remains available for arbitrary initial measures; no pointwise representative is silently inferred from the renewal model L1 datum.
The rest of the algorithm uses only atom ages and masses, never a spatial common width. It therefore needs no grid restriction or update change.
